title: When the Echo Burns
author: R. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Freya Pemberton, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
